0x00075A.en: 「With my skills now...@ this is my limit...!」

0x0007CB.en: 「Guh! This is as far as I go...!!」

0x000853.en: 「Damn it!@ Next time you won't get me!」

0x00097C.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AB8.en: 「Blowing it in a place like this...!@ This isn't funny...」

0x000B0C.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C5D.en: 「This is the end... the rest is on you.」

0x000CCB.en: 「Nngh! Did they get the jump on me...」

0x000D09.en: 「No good, I've taken too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000D56.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DDB.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000E86.en: 「Ugh... So I became a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000F05.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x000F7E.en: 「Oh maaan, they went an' got me!」

0x000FC2.en: 「Nn... gh! So this is the end...!」

0x00102F.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001076.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0010AB.en: 「Damn! So this is where my power ends...!」

0x001197.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x0011E5.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0012A0.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0012CF.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00130D.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00133C.en: 「I can't do any more than this. I'll take my leave.」

0x0013C7.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to pull out here...!」

0x0015EB.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00187F.en: (...Left shoulder verniers and thrusters, damaged.@ The damper stabilizer in my left ankle's sluggish too)

0x001905.en: (<Thrust> is down to 30%...@ 40 seconds until the <OS> finishes optimizing...)

0x00196B.en: (I'm so close to visual range, too)

0x00199C.en: (If Ares or Evil showed up right now...@ no, if the brothers came out here...)

0x0019FB.en: It's Masaki. Am I standing in the center?

0x001A2C.en: Over here too, am I properly centered?

0x001A69.en: The pixel offset shifts me to the left.

0x001AAD.en: Here, I'd like it to jump a little to the right.

0x001AF3.en: Moved the camera up a bit.

0x001B3A.en: I lined up to Masaki's right.@ By the way, I'm on a layer behind him.

0x001BA8.en: Now I'm on the same layer as Masaki.

0x001C1A.en: I really don't wanna be all alooone~~~~!

0x001C64.en: Serves you riiight~ do re mi fa~ <3

0x001D0D.en: Yes.@ Now then, let me lecture you on how to change the angle of view.

0x001D63.en: I changed the angle of view, how's that?@ The effect should be bigger now.

0x001E30.en: By the way, is that the only way to move the camera?

0x001E79.en: Well, for camera movement@ there are currently three methods.

0x001F07.en: Next, the decelerating movement we've been using.@ Let me slow the speed down a bit and try it.

0x001F6F.en: Changing the movement method and the actual move command are kept separate.

0x001FBB.en: You won't be changing the method very often, after all...

0x002004.en: You can also carry on a conversation while moving the camera.

0x002063.en: The dialogue keeps going while the screen moves!

0x0020CB.en: The screen jumps in an instant, like this.

0x002109.en: Ah, it teleported.@ The movement method carries over into normal conversations too.

0x002171.en: That's right, so don't forget to set it back.

0x0021D3.en: Or so I say, then come right back.

0x002236.en: (If there's a god in this world,@ give me 60 seconds... no, 30 seconds...!)

0x0022C6.en: (New pursuers... and this time it's not just Canis)

0x00230C.en: (Just like Papa said. There is no god, huh)

0x002346.en: (Sorry, Jyla... this may be where I fall)
